title.zh: Base推出「Earn&Borrow」功能，支持平台为用户提供稳定币收益和加密资产抵押借贷
title.en: Base推出「Earn&Borrow」功能，支持平台为用户提供稳定币收益和加密资产抵押借贷

current_state.zh: Base introduced an 'Earn&Borrow' feature allowing platforms to integrate third-party Base lending markets so users can earn floating stablecoin yield on USDC and borrow against crypto collateral, with Base/Coinbase explicitly disclaiming management or guarantees of the underlying vaults.
current_state.en: Base introduced an 'Earn&Borrow' feature allowing platforms to integrate third-party Base lending markets so users can earn floating stablecoin yield on USDC and borrow against crypto collateral, with Base/Coinbase explicitly disclaiming management or guarantees of the underlying vaults.
